summary: Iteration 72 — Transfer-to-Stock gate now unlocks on committed dealer offer OR TradeAPP price. Full backend + frontend verification. Backend (test_iteration_72_transfer_gate.py, 5/5 passing): (1) Dave (managerial) PATCH deal {dealer_offer_zar:250000} on a pending un-priced sub → 200, then POST /transfer-to-stock with fresh stock_number → 200 with body carrying the new stock id + stock_number. (2) Same endpoint with no priced_at and no dealer_offer → 400, response body contains both 'dealer offer' and 'fully valued' phrases (new copy). (3) Non-managerial dealer (minitest) → 403. (4) Managerial user targeting a foreign dealership's sub → 403. (5) Priced sub with no dealer offer still transfers → 200 (regression). Frontend (Playwright, 390x844, dave@tradeapp.co.za): pending sub TA-000219 baseline (dealer_offer_zar=0, no priced_at) shows the transfer-guard-notice with the EXACT new copy 'Transfer to stock unlocks once TradeAPP prices the vehicle or a managerial user commits their own offer. You can still mark the deal outcome below.' and transfer-to-stock-open-btn is NOT rendered. After PATCH-ing dealer_offer_zar=250000 + done=true and reloading, the guard notice disappears (count=0) and transfer-to-stock-open-btn IS rendered (count=1). Regression on priced sub (FB-000208): button visible, notice hidden. Access rules verified: managerial + owning dealership can transfer, non-managerial 403, foreign dealership 403. No bugs found.
action_items: No action required — feature works end-to-end across backend and frontend. Notice copy is exactly what the spec requested.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/stock.py line 328-340: correctly reads dealer_offer_zar from both sub.deal.dealer_offer_zar AND sub.dealer_offer_zar (legacy fallback) before deciding to reject. int() coerce with try/except is safe against string values.
routes/stock.py line 316-322: 403 chain unchanged — managerial-only + owning-dealership gate is intact; regression tests 3/4 confirm.
vehicle/[id].tsx line 2912-2914: isFullyValued = hasTradeAppPrice || hasDealerOffer correctly mirrors the backend rule (OR gate). Number() coerce handles string vs number safely.
TransferToStockCard.tsx line 121: notice text exactly matches spec. Line 218 gates the button on isFullyValued so the flow stays symmetric between guard notice and CTA.
